language.LongName: Language used for this sequence of acquisition

practice.LongName: First condition of the sequence (see Description).
practice.Description: The participants are asked to repeat out loud the sentences that are presented to them. This value represents the hearing threshold for a 50% rate of correct answers with these conditions: Speech presentation = Binaural/Noise presentation = Binaural. This condition is used as a practice/warm-up condition.
